# Mathilde Ulvsgärd-Hansted

Mathilde Ulvsgärd-Hansted is named once in the corpus as an Overlæge (senior consultant physician) in Region Sjællands Sygehusvæsen and as the representative of Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Selskab i Danmark in the steering group work for a Danish ADHD database [^src1]. No further biographical details, relationships, claims, or timeline events are available in the corpus.

Her listed role places her within the steering group for the ADHD database, a body whose membership spans all five Danish regions, relevant professional societies, patient organisations, and the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut), documented alongside appendices covering ADHD assessment and treatment data for the period 1 April 2024 – 31 March 2025 [^src1].
